sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, to be performed 
 on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block.
VMS consists of two parts:

Vibration and expansion monitoring 
system (4500 R)
Turbine Supervisory instrumentation

sections.text:
VMS monitoring system 4500R 
consists of two parts:

Electronic cabinet (I/O module, 
power supply, NIC module, terminal block, local indication of expansion ).

CSI software server (on line 
configuration, MHM analysis, point analysis, RBM ware) this server is used for 
all units and each unit has local (4500 R) and DCS graphics and monitoring 
information for all reading .

all units and each unit has local (4500 R) and DCS graphics and monitoring 
information for all reading .

sections.text:
الإشراف على التوربينات 
تتكون الأجهزة من:

a) Vibration sensors 
b) Expansion sensors

Vibration sensors is two types 
(absolute vibrations, relative shaft vibration)

Expansion sensors is two types 
(casing expansion, relative expansion)

Absolute vibration on bearing no. 
(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7)

Relative shaft vibration on bearing 
no. (1, 2, 3, 4, 7)

Casing expansion on bearing no. (1, 
2)

Relative expansion on bearing no. 
(1,2 (thrust), 3, 4)

All reading gives information about 
machinery health and it is used to mechanical problem analysis .

Testing of VMS:
Each VMS loop contains its own 
sensor /driver, data base configuration and I/O electronic modules

احتياطات السلامة

يجب إصدار تصريح العمل ويجب أن تحمل أدوات الصيانة المناسبة 
 فئة السلامة.

سياج أمان مع علامات تحذير 
 مطلوب المحيطة بمنطقة العمل.
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.
يجب أن تكون التوربينات خارج الخدمة.
